variables.name: pips
variables.notes: Money in your wallet (Pips).

variables.name: loan
variables.notes: Pips you still owe Mayor Ardea for your house. Starts with the 10,000 welcome loan.

variables.name: house_level
variables.notes: 1 = the starting house, 2 = expanded (bigger room). Raised by the expansion loan.

variables.name: day
variables.notes: Days since you moved in (day 1 = arrival). Goes up at 6 in the morning.

variables.name: hour
variables.notes: Clock hour, 0-23. The game starts at 9 in the morning; one game hour lasts one real minute.

variables.name: minute
variables.notes: Clock minutes, 0-59.

variables.name: tool
variables.notes: Tool in your hands: 0 hands, 1 shovel, 2 net, 3 fishing rod. L / R change it.

variables.name: net_on
variables.notes: 1 while the net is in your hands (lets A swing it).

variables.name: rod_on
variables.notes: 1 while the fishing rod is in your hands (lets A cast it).

variables.name: has_rod
variables.notes: You bought the fishing rod at Bramble's.

variables.name: intro
variables.notes: 0 = just arrived (talk to Mayor Ardea on the dock), 1 = you have your tools.

variables.name: entry
variables.notes: Which door you come out of in town: 0 dock, 1 your house, 2 shop, 3 museum, 4 Town Hall.

variables.name: saved
variables.notes: 1 once the game has been saved (CONTINUE on the title checks it).

variables.name: sale
variables.notes: Scratch: Pips earned by the last sale (shown in Bramble's dialog).

variables.name: gave
variables.notes: Scratch: exhibits donated in the last talk with Prof. Odessa.

variables.name: museum
variables.notes: How many of the 17 exhibits the museum has.
